_readme: Move tutor compatibility for every Pokémon in pokedex.json (keys = Pokémon names in pokedex.json). 'list' = the moves of the four tutors with their Pitch Black 2 type. 'tutor' = the tutor moves it can learn; 'new' = the ones it could NOT learn from a tutor in vanilla Black 2/White 2 (Pokémon from later generations and variants: compared with their official compatibility). Rules: every tutor move of its own types; up to 3 coverage moves that use its best attacking stat; punches, Low Kick and tail moves only for Pokémon with fists, legs or a tail; no Pledge moves for now.
